statements.statement: The patient presents with persistent palpitations and symptomatic bradycardia consistent with a history of sick sinus syndrome.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias and guide further management.
The diagnoses addressed are I49.5 and R00.2.
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197.
The denial was because required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
